#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    int ans = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < n && s[j] == s[i])
            j++;
        if ((j - i) % 2 == 0)

        i = j;
    }

    return 0;
}
